name: Local Causality as Accessibility Order Law
purpose: Define local causal structure as admissibility-ordered accessibility within bounded continuation domains.

candidate_law_statement.informal: A continuation event may locally influence another only when admissibility-compatible accessibility and bounded transport permit ordered continuation propagation within a reachable domain.

formal.local_causality_candidate: Cause_A(α,β) holds when β ∈ D_A(α), admissibility remains defined, and continuation ordering permits transport-compatible influence.
formal.ordering_condition: α ≺_A β is defined locally through recursive continuation ordering and admissibility-compatible propagation.
formal.bounded_causality_clause: Causal accessibility is bounded by finite transport flux, reinforcement stability, admissibility thresholds, and reconstruction accessibility.
formal.non_global_clause: Local causality does not imply global total ordering, universal determinism, or complete causal closure.
formal.non_spacetime_clause: Causal accessibility is a topology-conditioned continuation relation rather than a primitive spacetime geometry.
